purpose: Distinguish Proc.new unpack capture binding from ordinary yield-block unpack shadowing, with outer reads around invocation and separate body reference captures.

qualification.rule: The runner executes every pinned Crystal original case serially before any candidate case. Candidate runs only after all original stdout bytes equal the explicit expected files.
qualification.note: Expected bytes are explicit predictions grounded in original-first Proc.new capture cases from lavin11777; the new fixtures remain unqualified until the root oracle run.

source_anchors.fact: Block unpack is rewritten into a synthetic block argument and prepended MultiAssign statements; this transformation alone does not decide outer-flow visibility.
The ordinary Block visitor binds unpack leaves as block variables and ignores them when propagating block vars after the block.

When a block is consumed as a function pointer, semantic call handling constructs a ProcLiteral using the block body. In this conversion path, the normalized body assignments are passed to the Def body; Block unpacks metadata is not copied.
ProcLiteral typing visits its Def body in a function visitor; the converted normalized assignments are analyzed there.
Proc.new captures and returns the given block.

prior_original_first_evidence.observation: A typed overload distinguishes whether the outer UInt8 binding remains visible; original expected A proves the Proc.new unpack assignment changes the captured binding to Int32.
A typed overload distinguishes the outer Int32 binding from the String unpack assignment; original expected C demonstrates capture mutation.
A direct ProcLiteral multiassignment control confirms that assignments in its body can update a captured outer binding.
An ordinary yield block with unpacked leaves reports the original outer value after the block, consistent with block-local shadowing.

cases.name: proc_new_flat_collisions
checks: flat unpack leaf names collide with outer locals
reads outer values before Proc.new, after construction, and after invocation

cases.name: proc_new_nested_collisions
checks: nested unpack leaves collide with outer locals
reads outer values before Proc.new, after construction, and after invocation

cases.name: proc_literal_parameter_shadow
checks: ProcLiteral parameter has same name as outer local
reads outer local before construction, before invocation, and after invocation

cases.name: ordinary_block_unpack_shadow
checks: ordinary yield block has colliding flat unpack leaves
reads outer values before and after block invocation
